articles.title: After ‘three slaps in the face,’ Astros slugger Yordan Alvarez speaks up to stop a spiral
articles.description: Alvarez is one of the Astros' leaders by example, but he delivered a "personal" message after the Braves swept Houston on Sunday.

articles.title: Carlos Correa says quick comeback could’ve jeopardized availability for early 2027
articles.description: Correa denied earlier reports that the Astros were looking to move him to second base, but said he'd play wherever the team needs him.

articles.title: Astros’ Josh Hader collapses under the weight of a top-heavy roster
articles.description: Hader was forced to throw 44 pitches in Wednesday night's loss to the Mariners, another example of how the Astros have no margin for error.

articles.title: Astros back in control of their playoff destiny after pyrrhic victory over Mariners
articles.description: The Astros got a much-needed, complete team win in Seattle Tuesday night, but it may have come at a great cost.

articles.title: Even after everything goes wrong, Astros still control their playoff destiny
articles.description: Someone has to win the AL West. The Astros are still favored to do so, despite how poorly they played in Tampa.
